_comment: Cycle-charge stance demo (seed 12345): box-select the player's two cavalry regiments (right of the line, ~x 1027 and 1356, front ranks on the y=300 line, cavalry centres at y -180), press J to arm the Cycle charge stance, then right-click the enemy Infantry regiment at (291,723). The horse charges in, lands its momentum hit, then peels back to a standoff and charges AGAIN -- the caracole loop -- instead of grinding in melee once the charge bonus is spent. The HUD flashes 'Cycle charge' when J is pressed and the order cursor turns violet.

overlap.reason: Measured by tools/check.sh demo_defects on this tree, front-on-line deployment. uid1 (the player Infantry, pressed by the enemy foot) dips to nnd_min 1.56 wu against its 2.25 wu floor: transient press compression. uid8 (team 1's deep cavalry, 9 ranks) is under a continuous AI ATTACK order whose target re-selects mid-clip, and each retarget re-rotates the block before it has re-squared, compressing its own files: 2.97 wu against the 5.0 wu floor, the mechanism main already exempted for uid8 and #1546 tracks. uid9 (14.5 wu) no longer needs the exemption.

path_crossing.reason: Charging cavalry paths cross during the cycle-charge breakthrough, disengagement wheel, and realignment.
